description: This file is a shell script that defines functions and logic for managing a network interface using a cellular modem. It includes initialization, setup, and teardown procedures, as well as processing configuration variables and interacting with external utilities such as 'gcom' and 'json' for modem communication and configuration.

methods.name: proto_ncm_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration options for the NCM protocol, defining various parameters like device, apn, auth, username, password, and others.

methods.name: proto_ncm_setup
methods.description: Sets up the network interface by configuring the modem, establishing connection, and creating interface configurations for IPv4 and IPv6 as needed.

methods.name: proto_ncm_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the network interface by disconnecting the modem and performing necessary cleanup.
